summary: Navigator settings: execution-environment-image (--eei, default quay.io/ansible/ansible-runner:devel), execution-environment-volume-mounts (--eev src:dest:Z), log-append (--la, default True), log-file (--lf, default $PWD/ansible-navigator.log), log-level (--ll, debug to critical, default warning) and mode (-m stdout or interactive, default interactive).
questions: What is the default execution environment image for ansible-navigator?
How do I mount a directory into the execution environment with ansible-navigator?
Where is the ansible-navigator log file?
How do I set ansible-navigator to stdout mode by default?

answer_card.title: ansible-navigator image, mount, log and mode settings
answer_card.answer_md:
| Setting | CLI | Default |
|---|---|---|
| execution-environment-image | `--eei` | `quay.io/ansible/ansible-runner:devel` |
| execution-environment-volume-mounts | `--eev /src:/dest:Z` | none |
| log-file | `--lf` | `$PWD/ansible-navigator.log` |
| log-level | `--ll` (`debug`, `info`, `warning`, `error`, `critical`) | `warning` |
| log-append | `--la` | `True` |
| mode | `-m` (`stdout`, `interactive`) | `interactive` |
